summary:
Trends is the engine carrying every rating right now — all four ratings sit at 9-1 (90%, n=10) over the last 14 days with identical 7-game win streaks, miles ahead of season norms around 56%. Runs and hitting aren't far behind, both running 5-game win streaks across the board, while bullpen_fatigue is the lone soft spot, dead even at 50% with a 3-game losing streak for every rating. The strong-play ledger backs this up: R2 and R3 are both unbeaten or near it over 14 days (R2 6-1 for +5.0u, R3 3-0 for +3.0u), and all four ratings are profitable across 7, 14, and 30-day windows — there's no cold rating to fade today, just varying degrees of hot.

With only one game on the board, this is a single, concentrated shot: MIL @ TBR, and every rating converges on MIL, with deltas clustered tightly between -3.18 and -3.68 — about as clean a four-rating consensus as you'll see. That alignment matters because trends+runs and trends+bullpen are two of the best category combos in the model (57.3% and 56.9% hit rate respectively, n=700+), and both of those categories are riding their hottest stretch of the season into this exact matchup. MIL is also the single best team-when-liked in the sample — 50-22 (69%) overall and 28-12 (70%, +19.0u) specifically on strong plays — which stacks another layer of signal under the pick. Game is started by a TBD arm against Griffin Jax, so there's some rotation uncertainty, but with four-rating consensus, a top category combo in sync, and the model's best-performing team on the plus side, this profile is about as strong as the slate construction allows. Treat it as a premium single: lean into size here rather than spreading thin, since there's nothing else on the board to diversify against today.
